official_sources.basis: Official markdown retrieved using OpenAI Docs after source search; supplemental section observation, frozen baseline unchanged.
Official markdown retrieved using OpenAI Docs after source search; declarations contain no credential values.

observed_behavior: Actual loopback HTTP MCP initialize/tools/list requests carry static and environment-backed headers and bearer credentials with environment-over-static and bearer-over-Authorization precedence. No credential values are copied into serializable ACP metadata.

Source-bound host context hashes package root/manifest, discovered source identity, name, URL and declaration. Connection revalidates the source and rejects changed URL/name/config or package-injected host context, with no global credential map.

Credentials require HTTPS except loopback. Header values are marked sensitive; bad names/values, unavailable environment references, inline bearer_token, private auth and transport-owned overrides fail with value-free diagnostics. Plugin HTTP redirects are disabled; actual redirect trap receives no request.

Strict public per-server extensions.com.openai.auth none/oauth/mixed/api_key fields are parsed and retained verbatim, including explicit empty scopes. OAuth client provided/dcr/cimd, supported client auth methods, endpoints and OIDC settings have typed validation. Declarations never contain connection secrets. none/mixed can issue actual anonymous requests; oauth/API-key without separate host setup fail before HTTP. Explicit host connection configuration retains existing precedence.

Legacy OAuth aliases/configuration, resource and scopes are preserved in re-readable source declarations while client secrets never enter serializable runtime context; separate login is explicitly required. Portable client-owned headers remain filtered. Package manifest bytes remain unchanged during actual connection.
intentional_safety_differences: Snapshot header resolution warns/skips invalid values; this implementation fails the entire plugin MCP runtime admission for invalid or unavailable values.
Legacy credential-bearing non-loopback HTTP, transport-owned header overrides, all plugin redirects and ambiguous HTTP credential sources are rejected.

Public documented auth extensions are an explicit capability added beyond the frozen portable snapshot deny_unknown_fields behavior, with supplemental official section hashes recorded; unknown extension namespaces/fields and secret-bearing declarations remain rejected.
deferred_capabilities: OAuth discovery/authorization/user interaction and credential storage are tasks 26/27; token expiry/refresh is task 28. No OAuth completion or public protected-service evidence is claimed here.
HTTP header command helpers and other lifecycle/per-tool policy settings not implemented by this task remain explicit runtime errors. No helper shell command is executed.
Host context is consumed by VibeWindow MCP transport only, not claimed as an external ACP executor capability.
Only macOS local deterministic network evidence; actual public-service and cross-platform acceptance remain tasks 62-64.

package_integrity.basis: Original package manifest bytes compared before and after actual MCP HTTP exchange.

artifact_note: Raw .log and *.run.json stay local under repository rules; only code, neutral source metadata and this structured summary are committed.

verification.expected_result: Complete frozen baseline rejects task-only partial evidence; no complete compatibility claim.
